audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Shen levels 3, 4-5, first item and 2+ items, but whys[1] through whys[6] all describe Gnar controlling those stages or the lane being even.
audit.why: The packet chart and the already-audited mirror both read Gnar, Gnar, Gnar, Gnar, Skill, Gnar, Skill. The whys text already argued that version; only the enum tokens disagreed.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-6 flipped to Gnar, Gnar, Gnar, Skill, Gnar, Skill in matched full/content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer named Iceborn Gauntlet as the deciding first-item spike and treated level 6 as Shen's stage; neither is what actually happens.
audit.why: GNAR! is 90/60/30s — at rank 3 it is up almost every skirmish, and Gnar's first item is what makes Mega's burst punish a mistimed taunt. Shen's level-6 value here is map equity, not a lane flip.
audit.corrected: Level-6 and first-item phase text rewritten to Gnar's spikes with the real GNAR! cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page said that Gnar can cancel Stand United, and Spirit's Refuge was described as if it answered his poke.
audit.why: Stand United is a channel — any CC interrupts it — and Mega Gnar has two stuns, Wallop (W, 7s) and GNAR! (R, 90/60/30s), either of which kills the teleport and the shield with it. Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks only, so Boomerang Throw, Boulder Toss and their slows pass straight through.
audit.corrected: Channel-cancel interaction written into the level-6 phase text, the key-interactions report row and wants.foe[1]; W's attack-only limit written into the level-3 phase text.

audit.why: suspectNames flagged 'Use Spirit's Refuge' — false positive; Spirit's Refuge is the correct Riot name.

edits.before: W spirit zone blanks his auto window. Only take the trade when Gnar's GNAR! is down.
edits.after: Hop (E) resets the gap on a 22s cooldown — spend Shadow Dash only after he spends it.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Gnar must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks only — Boomerang Throw and its slow pass straight through, so W is no answer to his poke.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around GNAR!'s cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Mini kites your 600-range dash in the open and Hop resets it — you need terrain or a wave corner to land E at all.

edits.before: Stand United makes your lane a 1v2 for the enemy MAP — track every low ally. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Gnar's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: GNAR! is 90s at rank 1 and Wallop stuns on 7s — either cancels your Stand United channel, so never start R inside Mega's reach.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on GNAR!'s cooldown.
edits.after: His first item makes Mega's burst punish any taunt thrown with W down — read the rage bar.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Gnar carry threat 8/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items in it is even — carry threat 8/10, and the fight is decided by whose CC lands first, not by raw stats.

edits.before: Track Gnar's GNAR! (Mega Stun): His Mega all-in. Dodge it. When it is down — E-Q + R him.
edits.after: GNAR! and Wallop both stun — either cancels Stand United's channel. Never R beside Mega.

edits.before: Pin you against terrain with GNAR! multi-stun when your Spirit's Refuge or Shadow Dash is on cooldown
edits.after: Cancel your Stand United channel with Wallop or GNAR! — either stun kills the teleport and the shield with it

notes: Third Shen matchup in a row where the two layers agreed with each other but both contradicted the packet chart and the mirror — the enum tokens look batch-generated independently of the whys text. Left diffRating 7.5/10 and carryRating 8/10 alone despite a 53.01% win rate over 1594 games; the packet itself flags the chart/win-rate tension, and with the corrected chart Gnar holds four of seven stages in a lane Shen wins on average, which is worth a human look.
